symptoms: factory-daemon recovery task remains in planning or running after the daemon process is restarted
execution_recovery stays active even though verified completed tasks and a runnable artifact already exist
daemon keeps reporting active_recovery_task_ids without fresh heartbeat progress

required_signals: checkpoint heartbeat is stale beyond the detached runner timeslice
secondary_signals: recent_completed_tasks already meets the recovery target
daemon was restarted after the recovery task was created

policy.orchestrator: During ensure_execution_recovery, detect stale recovery tasks. If recovery targets are already satisfied, close the stale task instead of keeping recovery mode active forever. If targets are not yet satisfied, relaunch the detached recovery runner.
policy.validation: Bind recovery exit to verified completed tasks and runnable artifact evidence, not to the existence of a historical planning task.
